verdict.rationale: Parahelp's Customer Agent works as a team member inside Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain, and Pylon. It also runs standalone via an API outside any ticketing system. It reads historical tickets from the connected helpdesk, and replies as a designated agent user via token plus webhook, which implies two-way ticket flow. Missing for 10: any evidence of Salesforce support, explicit documentation of bidirectional ticket/context sync semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
